name: 読んだ語と保存と練習の四指標
prompt: Redesign the existing Japanese four-metric learning summary as a compact 390×164 mobile grid matching the native preview. The native preview is authoritative for layout and Japanese copy. The original Vocabulary screenshot is secondary context only; do not copy its beige background or decorative icons. The attached user image is palette preference only, not geometry or content. Remove the pale mint fills completely. Use a pure white canvas and four white metric tiles with thin light neutral gray outlines (#E5E7EB), modest rounded corners and clear gutters. Keep the exact 2×2 order and exact content: 128 / 読んだ語, 4 / お気に入り, 7 / 保存した語, 10 / 練習した回数. Use near-black bold numerals and dark neutral labels, Meiryo-compatible Japanese type, and simple consistent inset spacing. Do not add icons, titles, badges, green emphasis, gradients, shadows, tinted backgrounds, or extra copy. Preserve the clean, compact native grid.
reviewNotes: White metric tiles and neutral outlines remove the mint tint; native 2x2 order and aspect are preserved. Pending owner review.
